create_fp4_kv_cache_buffers: create FP4 KV cache buffers for a given model with specified head dimensions and layer count
quantize_and_store_kv_cache: quantize KV cache tensors and store them in FP4 format with per-block scaling factors
dequantize_fp4_kv_to_fp8: dequantize stored FP4 KV cache tensors back to FP8 E4M3 format for FlashInfer prefill kernel
compute_fp4_cell_size: compute the per-token memory footprint in bytes for FP4 KV cache capacity estimation
get_fp4_quant_method_by_name: instantiate an FP4 KV cache quantization method by recipe name from the registry
